title: Package pr-reviewer in nix and migrate four manual LaunchAgents
intent: Declare pr-reviewer as a nix package (buildRustPackage pinned to upstream rev 4d27724, since upstream ships no flake and it is absent from nixpkgs) and add it as a nix-darwin LaunchAgent so it starts at login. Additionally migrate four hand-written plists (com.dktaohan.foundry-proxy, com.lego.btsbox.devrel, com.lego.btsbox.devrel.serve, com.gascity.bd.companion) into modules/M-02877/darwin.nix launchd.user.agents. Also repoint pr-reviewer's devrel-infra local_path off a stale ephemeral Decapod worktree onto the real checkout.
proof_hooks: nix build of pr-reviewer package succeeds with pinned cargoHash
darwin-rebuild build evaluates with all five agents declared
launchctl list shows the five labels after switch
unknowns: cargoHash must be derived by building; not knowable ahead of time
btsbox and bd binaries live in ~/.local/bin and are not nix-managed, so their plists must keep absolute non-store paths
